text:
Ravi: quick idea: introduce 'soft-slot borrowing' (grace windows) between enqueue and coalesce so bursty requests can win a small, time-boxed chance to complete without touching reserved pools
Sasha: failure modes? could this amplify hotspots
Ravi: main risks: repeated borrows thrash coalescer, wasted KV populates, headroom accounting confusion. mitigate w/ rate limits, decay counters, global cap
Eli: propose invariants: 1) soft-slots never preempt reserved capacity, 2) token cap + time cap per borrow, 3) per-tenant backoff after failures
Nora: how to implement without huge coalescer changes?
Ravi: shim = enqueue -> borrow-check -> tag(request.soft=true) -> coalesce. coalescer treats tagged requests as low-weight candidates when forming bundles
Eli: explain weight semantics
Ravi: weights like reserved=100, steady=50, soft=10. bundler prefers high weights but can include soft if room exists. avoids soft starving heavy requests
Sasha: telemetry needed: borrow_attempts, borrow_success, borrow_evicted, soft_batch_size_hist, soft_fallback_rate, kv_transient_hits
Nora: KV cost: if soft primes KV and gets evicted we pay twice
Eli: suggestion: mark soft-induced KV entries as transient TTL short and don't pin to prefetch queues
Sasha: UX: tenants auto-eligible or opt-in. auto uses hysteresis to avoid flip-flop
Ravi: spike-detection rule: enable after 3 P95 breaches in 30s, disable after 5m calm (config knobs)
Eli: code sketch for borrow-check:
```
bool try_borrow(tenant) {
  if (tenant.is_reserved) return false;
  if (!tenant.soft_enabled) return false;
  if (tenant.borrow_count >= cfg.max_per_min) return false;
  if (global_soft_pct > cfg.max_global_pct) return false;
  tenant.borrow_count++;
  return true;
}
```
infra-bot: scheduled: batcher/soft-slot-shim alpha -> staging on 2026-04-01T04:00Z :rocket:
Ravi: rollout: 10 canary tenants, gate on no increase in reserved 99P latency, monitor soft cost-per-token
Nora: add global shield: auto-disable soft if evictions spike > X for 1m
Eli: make borrow idempotent for retries to avoid double-counting
Sasha: dashboards: per-tenant borrow success/fail, last-eviction, avg soft-batch size
Ravi: next steps: RFC with invariants & weight semantics (I'll draft), telemetry spec (Nora owns), shim + tests (Eli). TL;DR: soft-slot borrowing = tunable grace windows: token+time caps, admission weights, hysteresis, soft-KV TTLs, telemetry + global shield :thumbsup:
